hub.integrationsText: What Spook adds per integration: automations, scripts, lights, helpers and the rest. Repairs that spot what stopped working, new actions, new entities.
hub.coreExtensionsText: Actions for Home Assistant itself: manage areas, floors, labels, devices, entities and integrations from an automation or script.
hub.helpersText: Take an entity you have, get a new one with the result: a corrected sensor, the opposite state, or how long something has been the way it is.
hub.triggersConditionsText: For the automations Home Assistant cannot quite express, like a cron schedule or several things happening together. Plus a few things that are mostly fun.
hub.assistantsText: Let an AI assistant ask Spook what is wrong in your home, where something is used, and whether a draft automation holds up.

meta.title: Spook 👻 A scary powerful toolbox for Home Assistant
meta.description: Spook is a scary powerful toolbox for Home Assistant 👻 It finds the ghosts in your setup and adds the actions, triggers and conditions Home Assistant leaves out.

home.headline: A scary powerful toolbox{br}for Home Assistant
home.description: Hi! I'm Spook 👻 I find the ghosts in your Home Assistant, like an automation still pointing at a device you removed months ago. And I bring the actions, triggers and conditions Home Assistant leaves out.
home.heroAlt: The repairs dashboard of Home Assistant with seven repairs from Spook, like an empty area, an unused label and an automation using entities that no longer exist.
home.estimate: Estimated from Home Assistant's opt-in analytics: about one in four installations shares its data, so the count there is multiplied by four.

toolbox.headline: What's in the toolbox 🧰
toolbox.title: Stuff Home Assistant won't ship.{br}Stuff you wanted anyway.
toolbox.ghostsText: I float around your instance and raise {count} kinds of issues on your repairs dashboard: references to things that are gone, empty areas, unused labels. Found before they bite you.
toolbox.triggersText: For the moments Home Assistant cannot name: a cron schedule, an automation switched off, a device that just showed up, a cooldown since the last run.
toolbox.integrationsText: New actions and repairs for {count} integrations you already run, from automations and dashboards to lights and thermostats.
toolbox.actionsText: Little building blocks that make your automations smarter: the actions you always reached for and never found.

steps.headline: How the haunting works 🕯️
steps.title: Three steps to spooked.
steps.installText: Find Spook in the Marketplace of your Home Assistant, or in HACS before 2026.11, and select Install.
steps.setUpText: Add the Spook integration, read what it says hello with, and select Submit.
steps.seeText: Problems show up on your repairs dashboard, and the new actions, triggers and conditions are ready to use. 👻

example.headline: Looks like everything else
example.title: Nothing new to learn.
example.description: Spook's triggers, conditions and actions work like the ones Home Assistant ships: pick them in the automation editor, fill them in, save. Rather write YAML? That works too. This one turns the kitchen lights on at half past six, on weekdays.
example.alt: The automation in the Home Assistant editor, using Spook's cron schedule trigger and cooldown condition.
